as_name.description: Filter by AS organization name (case-insensitive partial match). Examples: 'Cogent', 'Level3', 'NTT'. Useful when you don't know the exact ASN.

asn.description: Filter by Autonomous System Number. Examples: 174 (Cogent), 3356 (Level3), 1299 (Arelion). Returns all communities defined by this AS.

country.description: Filter by country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., 'US', 'DE', 'JP'). Returns communities from ASNs in the specified country.

description.description: Filter by description text (case-insensitive partial match). Examples: 'blackhole', 'localpref', 'prepend'. Useful for finding communities with specific functions.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (0-indexed, default: 0). Use for browsing large result sets.

page_size.description: Results per page (default: 10, max: 1000). Use smaller values (10-50) for quick lookups, larger values (100-500) for bulk analysis.

value.description: Specific community value to lookup (e.g., '174:21000' or '174:20xxx'). Supports wildcard patterns. Returns exact and wildcard range matches.
